name: The same without the lock (QA hook): both tabs send the same refresh token, the second one gets invalid_grant
description: Shows the race the lock removes. With "Revoke Refresh Token" in the realm the reuse also revokes the refresh token the first tab has just received: the next renewal fails in both tabs and the "Sign in again?" popup is shown while the user did nothing wrong.
